blocks.orig: Sailing along the coastline of Zanzibar on a traditional Arabian dhow is a beautiful experience. Your dhow cruise departs at 4:30 pm from Stone Town and sails along the off-shores of this historical and fascinating town. As you sail, the sun slowly sinks into the Indian Ocean, painting the town and the skies in amazing pastel colours. A variety of snacks, beer and soft drinks are on board, and you enjoy live music as the dhow glides further over the ocean.
blocks.html: Cruising the Zanzibar coastline on a traditional Arabian dhow is a lovely experience. Your dhow leaves from Stone Town at 4:30 pm and sails off the shores of this fascinating, historic town. While you sail, the sun gradually sets into the Indian Ocean, colouring the town and the sky in wonderful pastel shades. On board there are various snacks, beer and soft drinks, and you can enjoy live music while the dhow glides on across the ocean.
